$comment: Peer-dependency issues reported by `pnpm peers check` that this repository accepts. Read by scripts/verify-peer-deps.mjs, which fails on an issue that is NOT listed here AND on an entry here that matches nothing pnpm reports. Both directions, because a dead acceptance is how a live gap hides behind it. Added by F-143.

unsatisfied.why: WEB, AND THIS PRODUCT HAS NO WEB SURFACE (ADR-0051). The requesters are @radix-ui/* and vaul, which arrive under a transitive tooling dependency and render DOM. `apps/mobile` is the only surface; nothing in it imports React DOM, the boundary guard fails on a screen that tries, and the app.config.ts platform list is iOS and Android. Installing react-dom to satisfy a package the product never loads would add a dependency to quiet a warning, which is the trade this register exists to refuse. It is listed rather than filtered so that the day a web target IS considered, this is a decision somebody re-reads rather than a line in a script.
